description: Activate a CDS view. Use after CreateDdl or UpdateDdl if the object remains inactive.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

session_id.description: Session ID from GetSession. If not provided, a new session will be created.

session_state.description: Session state from GetSession (cookies, csrf_token, cookie_store). Required if session_id is provided.

name: ActivateDdl
